title: Frutiger Aero
summary: Glass, water, sky, and gloss. Optimistic technology from the mid-2000s.
lede: A design style common from the mid-2000s to the early 2010s: glossy and translucent interface elements, blue and green gradients, water, bubbles, sky, and grass, and humanist sans-serif type. The Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute named it in 2018.

era.note: Wikipedia: mid-2000s to early 2010s, with a revival as an internet aesthetic from 2023.

attestation.label: Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute: Frutiger Aero

lineage.label: Aqua (user interface)
lineage.note: Apple’s Aqua theme introduced water-like, reflective, translucent controls.

lineage.label: Windows Aero
lineage.note: Windows Vista (2006) and Windows 7 made glass, animation, and translucency the default desktop look. The style’s name refers to it.

lineage.label: Y2K aesthetic
lineage.note: Wikipedia describes Frutiger Aero as the successor to the Y2K aesthetic.

lineage.label: Glassmorphism
lineage.note: A 2020s style with frosted, blurred panels but without gloss highlights or nature imagery.

grammar.text: Buttons and panels have a bright highlight on the upper half, reflections, and translucency.
Blues, aquas, and fresh greens on white, usually as vertical gradients.
Water drops, bubbles, fish, green hills, clouds, and lens flares, often combined with technology.
Frutiger, Segoe UI, Myriad, and similar open, friendly typefaces.
Rounded corners, soft drop shadows, and floor reflections under objects.

diagnostic: Interface elements have a glossy highlight or glass translucency.
Blue, aqua, or green gradients dominate.
Images show water, sky, bubbles, or green landscapes, often with technology.
Corners are rounded and shadows are soft.
counter: Flat color with no gradients or highlights.
Hard offset shadows or thick black outlines.

confusions.difference: Glassmorphism uses frosted blur over colorful backgrounds, but no gloss highlight, reflections, or nature imagery.
Y2K prefers chrome, silver, and cyber-futurism. Frutiger Aero prefers water, sky, and green nature.
Skeuomorphic design imitates real materials such as leather and paper. Frutiger Aero imitates glass and water and stays optimistic and airy.

do: Use a sky-to-white or aqua-to-blue vertical gradient for the page or hero background.
Give primary buttons a pill shape, a gradient fill, and a white highlight on the upper half.
Use translucent white panels with a light border and a soft shadow.
Use a humanist sans-serif such as Segoe UI, Frutiger, or Myriad.
Add nature imagery: water, bubbles, clouds, or grass.
dont: Do not use hard offset shadows or thick black outlines.
Do not use dark mode or desaturated palettes as the base.
Do not reduce contrast for gloss effects. Keep text readable on every gradient.

synthesis: Operating systems set the look: [Windows Vista](ref:windows-vista-aero-interface) and [Windows 7](ref:windows-7-aero-interface) glass, with [Aqua](ref:mac-os-x-aqua-interface) and the [Bliss wallpaper](ref:bliss-windows-xp-wallpaper-1996) as precursors, and the open-source [KDE Plasma 4](ref:kde-plasma-4-desktop) desktop as a parallel.

Stock imagery and icons spread it beyond software: the [Asadal globe image](ref:asadal-earth-and-city-10-2007) and the [Crystal Clear icons](ref:crystal-clear-icons-everaldo-coelho). The [Wii menu](ref:wii-menu-2006) and a [post office interior](ref:poste-italiane-agenzia-62-iosa-ghini-2007) show it in consoles and architecture.

The period’s websites carried the style less than the software did. The [Windows 7](ref:windows-7-website-2009) and [Leopard](ref:apple-leopard-website-2007) sites show glossy objects, sky gradients, grass, and aurora, while the [Vista](ref:windows-vista-website-2007) and [Messenger](ref:windows-live-messenger-website-2009) pages keep only pale blue headers.
The name’s link to the [Frutiger](ref:frutiger-typeface-1976) typeface is loose. The interfaces mostly used [Segoe UI](ref:segoe-ui-typeface) and similar faces.

The fingerprint describes CSS implementations. The archived 2007–2009 product sites fail it: they drew gloss, gradients, and rounded corners with images, so computed styles show flat, square boxes, and their screenshot palettes are mostly pale blue and white. Judge historical pages with the rubric, not the fingerprint.
